scope_note: This maps the materials to which Freud said interpretation applied; it does not validate any particular interpretation or symbolic dictionary.
statement: Freud's 1904 account applied interpretation to patients' associations, dreams, symptomatic acts, and everyday slips.
statement_zh: Freud 1904 年的說明把詮釋運用於病人的聯想、夢、症狀性行為與日常失誤。
